timeline.summary: Travel vlog and classroom setup; the first roughly 90 seconds lack useful ASR.
Mikey gives gendered relationship judgments, then critiques a student's nervous smile, small movements and voice/body mismatch.
Classroom and student reports frame inner restrictions, release and meditation as the basis for lasting change; outcomes are not independently tested.
He says to step back and reduce pressure when a woman physically retreats, followed by a fragmentary student/date report.
He discusses clear but non-obscene intent, demonstrates public approaches and discusses nightlife timing and contact collection.
Further night interactions are edited and do not independently establish consent, contact exchange or later outcomes.
Students give positive course testimonials and Mikey closes with course promotion.

visual_findings: All 31 sampled frames were reviewed: airport/travel, classroom teaching, outdoor coaching, night approaches and testimonial/promotion scenes.
Faces are often blurred, but location, companions, body position, phones and interaction context remain privacy-sensitive.
Sampled frames confirm the same visual sequence as mikey-sijiao-003 but do not independently prove contact ownership, durable course effects or later outcomes.

permissions.reason: Duplicate of a formal source and mixed with unsafe tactics, unverified psychological causality, gender stereotypes and promotional testimony.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not checked word-for-word against original audio.
Sparse frames do not equal continuous audio-visual verification.
Same-upload reuse is based on identity, duration, sequence, substantial transcript overlap and visual match despite ASR differences.
